posts.author: mirrormagic
posts.body:
I don't think that I've ever made an introduction post about myself (despitte being on these forums for a few weeks now XD) so I guess it's time for me to do that.
I've heard of RPG Maker in the past, especially since I was a massive fan of Ib, Yume Nikki, and the like back then (and still now tbh; I still play Yume 2kki a looooooot), but I only really started getting into making games this summer. I bought MZ and MV since they were both on sale and also couldnt really decide which of the versions to get XD--even though in the end, I just stuck with MZ since that's the most recent version.
Usually, I'm more of a writer than an artist--god knows i suck at drawing anatomy and scale--but making games here lets me visualize things that would be harder to write as text in a word doc. I've already made a game and published it (you can play it
here!
it was for a game jam and i cobbled it together in 4 days xp) but now I'm working on a much bigger, much more detailed project that's been simmering in my head. I don't really want to spoil too much of the plot, but it'll be inspired by a certain monster in the Magnus Archives, if anyone here has listened to it. Maybe I'll make a full post for it later in the 'Games in Development' forum, but for now, I'm just working to iron out the finer details (and maybe make a demo...)
For now though, I'm happy to be here and talk to other artists!!
